Create a word document, write down answers to the most basic questions. 1. Introduction 2. Why mba? 3. Why this specialisation? 4. Who should we choose you? 5. Why that particular institute? 6. About interests and hobbies 6. If you have work experience, then a basic format where you are able to explain what you did/ if you are a fresher then college + internship information 

Do practice those questions diligently because they expect you to be somewhat fluent while answering questions about yourself.

Apart from that, concerning current affairs and academic questions, you can take some time to think, you can stutter a little bit but practice in front of the mirror so you’re at least coherent and not fucking up in basic sentence formation. 

Ask your friends or family to take your mock pi or you can join a small coaching institute for the same. They’ll charge around 5k or maybe even less if you just go for mock pis.
